hiddenTests.testCode: Cache c1 = new Cache(); int[] calls1 = {0}; java.util.function.Supplier<Integer> s1 = () -> { calls1[0]++; try { Thread.sleep(20); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } return 7; }; java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier b1 = new java.util.concurrent.CyclicBarrier(8); Thread[] ts1 = new Thread[8]; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { ts1[i] = new Thread(() -> { try { b1.await(); c1.getOrCompute("k", s1); } catch (Exception ignored) {} }); ts1[i].start(); } for (Thread t : ts1) { try { t.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } assertTrue("supplier calls=" + calls1[0], calls1[0] == 1);
hiddenTests.description: 边界：8 线程 CyclicBarrier 同步并发取同一 key，supplier 只允许计算一次（bug 必挂）
